draft.description: An in-progress article draft. Every field is optional, unlike site.standard.document, since a draft may be incomplete. THIS IS A TEMPORARY UNSPECCED LEXICON, specific to this fork's article-authoring feature.

coverImage.description: Image to use for thumbnail or cover image. Less than 1MB in size.

bodyImages.description: Blob refs for images embedded in the draft body. Stored here because a BlobRef cannot be reconstructed from the CID in a markdown getBlob URL alone - mimeType and size are unreadable for a blob that was never tethered - so without this the refs would not survive closing the composer, and republishing a reopened draft would silently drop its images. Drafts live in private stash and these blobs stay untethered, so they are not publicly enumerable via com.atproto.sync.listBlobs; they are tethered only at publish, into com.sunnahsky.article.assets.

bodyImage.description: One image embedded in a draft body: the blob ref that will be tethered at publish, plus the filename to show while the image itself cannot be rendered.

name.description: Original filename as reported by the picker, shown in the composer's placeholder so the author can tell which image sits where while it cannot be displayed. Display only - never used to construct a path or a URL, and absent when the picker reports no filename. Consumers MUST sanitise before rendering: escape as text rather than markup, and strip Unicode bidi controls.

id.description: A TID to be used as a draft identifier.

draftWithId.description: A draft with an identifier, used to store drafts in private storage (stash).
